name: Arnold von Leroy
original_name: アルノルト・フォン・ルロイ
source:
Arnold is the 23rd head of the Leroy family, a direct descendant of Earl Leroy, who is said to be cursed. Arnold's parents died when he was young, and his grandmother, who had taken care of him since then, also died recently. He has a kind personality and presents himself in a mature way due to his position, but there are times when he allows himself to shows his childish side too. He likes wine and Assam tea. His hobbies are reading and horseback riding. He is good at playing the piano.
